items.text: Patrick Sheehan has represented the 37th House District since April 2024. He has served nearly two decades as a law enforcement officer and previously was a Lockport alderman and township park commissioner.

sentences.text: Patrick Sheehan has represented the 37th House District since April 2024.
He has served nearly two decades as a law enforcement officer and previously was a Lockport alderman and township park commissioner.

items.text: His campaign says he supports capping gasoline taxes and eliminating the grocery tax while keeping local government revenue stable. His campaign also says he opposes Illinois' SAFE-T Act and its elimination of cash bail. House records list two of his sponsored bills as public acts: HB1842 on municipal code administrative adjudication and HB2270 on transportation. He introduced a bill for a first responder income tax credit.
